text:
kai: noticing a spike in GPU attach errors in us-west2 at ~03:21 UTC. Ops alert showed 42 failures in 5m.

ops-bot: ALERT gpu-attach-failures us-west2 count=42 window=5m link=https://grafana/alerts/882 :rotating_light:

dana: cursory metrics -> scratchpool IOPS burst 18k, pattern looks like concurrent janitor sweeps (many small deletes).

maria: SMART temps up on several gnodes (188->202) and media-retry count rising. Attach latency increased to >600ms.

ajay: hypothesis: janitor concurrency too high during attach waves causing NVMe queueing. Short fix: reduce janitor concurrency and throttle per-node. Patch suggestion: `max_concurrency=3` and `rate_qps=5`. Add attach fallback to warm-pool at 400ms.

kai: patched 6-node canary at 03:35 with max_concurrency=3. Attach failures dropped to 3 within 12m. Latency median fell to ~170ms.

dana: plan: staged regional rollout + telemetry change. Add `backscatter_index = scrub_rw_bytes / attach_ops` and alert when >0.7. Also schedule heavy scrubs to off-peak.

maria: opened INFRA-17077 for follow-ups (owners: kai/dana/maria). ops-bot created action.

ops-bot: ACTION_CREATED INFRA-17077 https://redwood/infra/tickets/17077 assigned=[kai,dana,maria] priority=P1

ajay: closing loop for now. Will monitor and write postmortem if it recurs. :thumbsup:
